title: Hanasato Minori — Chasing My Seniors〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: The Warmth of a Guiding Hand

rows.Line: Campground

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, we did it...!
Our curry is finally complete!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Bring the camera in a little closer!
What do you think? It looks creamy and delicious, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh no... I'm getting really hungry now!
Can we start digging in?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, why don't we begin?

rows.Speaker: Minori, Shizuku, Airi & Haruka
rows.Line: Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mmm! I love these big chunky veggies! It really feels like we're camping now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: On top of that, Minori, the curry you and Airi made has such a gentle flavor to it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
The rice you two made is also really good.
How'd that go? It's pretty hard to cook rice using just camping gear.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Getting the measurements and timing right wasn't a problem, but controlling the heat was a bit tricky. The bottom became quite burnt as a result...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What are you talking about?! That crispy bottom's the best part! I think you're giving yourself far too little credit.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree. The texture's perfect, and I love it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm really glad you two like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We still have plenty, so please feel free to ask for more.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
I'm definitely having some more!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, I really wasn't expecting this curry to turn out so well when we first started the shoot...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me neither. We did draw from a hat to decide our pairs and what tools we'd be using, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting our tools to end up falling into two extremes like that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Next, we have our fire-starting tools.
Airi, Minori, which of you is going to draw for your pair?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me! Minori Hanasato is poised and ready to draw!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm counting on you, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hmm...!
Please give me something good! Please give me something good...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This one! What do we get?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Lemme see!
We'll be using... Wait, what...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
A strap drill...?
I've got a bad feeling about this...

rows.Speaker: Show Staff Member
rows.Line: Ah, the strap drill is right over here! Enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Wait, this looks like...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I knew it!
We're back in the Stone Age!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry, Airi!
If only my luck weren't so terrible...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's okay, Minori. I have a plan.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I learned how to use one of these years ago on a survival program.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, you can count on me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-You're my hero...!
I promise to do everything I can to help get our fire started!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: For the sake of our curry!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's the spirit.
We can't let it end up as just a plate of rice!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't get it! Why won't it start?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-But I'm seeing a lot of smoke...!
Wait, what if the wood isn't dry enough?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's possible.
At this rate, we're never gonna get our fire going...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi! Let me take over!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I drew the short straw...
And, I can't make you do all the work!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I don't have as much experience with this as you do, but I'm not gonna give up! I promise to get our fire started no matter what!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, here goes nothing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Gnaaaaaaaaargh!!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Start! Start! Staaaaaaaaaart!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, that isn't gonna work.
The goal isn't to spin it as fast as possible.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You gotta use as much of the string as you can and get into a good rhythm.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Okay...!
Lemme try again with that in mind!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I still can't believe we managed to get that fire started and make this curry.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha... To be fair, I felt so exhausted after getting our fire started that Airi had to do all the cooking.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What are you saying?
I thought you were really cool when you did that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You didn't give up. You kept trying...
Not only that, you succeeded. I wouldn't have expected anything less from you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That means we're able to have this delicious curry together because of you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you very much, Minori.
We're grateful for all the hard work you put in for us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
N-No, I...!
I just felt that I couldn't give up is all...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean, we're having this curry now because we all worked together to make it happen! I don't deserve all the credit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
This is our curry.
It's MORE MORE CURRY!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
MORE MORE CURRY!, huh?
Hehe. Yeah, we did all work really hard on it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I can't put it into words, but it really tastes wonderful. I'd love it if we could go camping together again someday.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, me too!
